ui.kanjiIndexHint.zh: 本教材按 {count} 字一课编排。字形、读音、例词和例句一起学习，测验单独进行。
ui.kanjiIndexHint.en: This book is arranged in lessons of {count} kanji. Forms, readings, example words and sentences stay together, with a separate quiz.

ui.kanjiWordReadings.zh: 本字暂无单独的音读、训读资料，以下为本课词汇读音。
ui.kanjiWordReadings.en: Separate on and kun readings are not available for this character. Vocabulary readings from this lesson are shown below.

ui.kanjiNoExamples.zh: 本字的教材资料暂未收录例句。
ui.kanjiNoExamples.en: The textbook material for this character does not currently include example sentences.

ui.resumeNote.en: Return to your last opened lesson

ui.startNote.zh: 也可以去「教材库」选择正在学的教材
ui.startNote.en: Or pick your textbook in the Library

ui.snapshotNote.zh: 收藏生词、标记掌握，每一次复习都算数。
ui.snapshotNote.en: Save words and mark what you know as you study.

ui.noPracticeNote.zh: 完成自测后，这里会显示你的成绩。

ui.search.en: Find a lesson or Japanese title

ui.speechUnavailable.en: Speech playback is unavailable in this browser.

ui.finishAll.zh: 请完成全部题目后提交。

ui.pending.en: This material has not been added yet.

ui.error.zh: 内容暂时无法加载，请重试或返回索引。
ui.error.en: This lesson could not be loaded. Retry or return to the index.

ui.imported.zh: 已合并导入的学习记录。

ui.invalidFile.zh: 文件格式不正确，请选择本站导出的学习记录。
ui.invalidFile.en: Choose a valid progress file exported from this site.

ui.localOnly.zh: 记录保存在当前浏览器。换设备前可以导出；新站不会自动读取旧站的记录。
ui.localOnly.en: Progress stays in this browser. Export it before changing devices. Records from the old site are not read automatically.

ui.storageError.zh: 浏览器暂时无法保存；本次仍可继续学习，请导出记录备份。
ui.storageError.en: Browser storage is unavailable. You can keep studying; export your progress to keep a backup.

ui.speechLoading.zh: 正在等待设备日语声音加载…

ui.speechNoJapanese.zh: 系统里只有非日语声音，已经全部隐藏。装好日语语音包后点「重新检测声音」。
ui.speechNoJapanese.en: The system only reports non-Japanese voices, so they are hidden. Install the Japanese voice data, then tap Check voices again.

ui.speechNoEngine.zh: 浏览器没有报告任何声音引擎。请在系统设置里启用文字转语音（TTS）后，再点「重新检测声音」。
ui.speechNoEngine.en: The browser reports no speech engine at all. Enable text-to-speech in the system settings, then tap Check voices again.

ui.speechUnsupported.zh: 此浏览器不支持设备朗读。请使用支持 Web Speech API 的浏览器。
ui.speechUnsupported.en: This browser does not support device speech. Use a browser with Web Speech API support.

ui.speechFailed.zh: 设备朗读失败，请重新点击朗读或选择其他声音。
ui.speechFailed.en: Device speech failed. Click Read aloud again or choose another voice.

ui.speechVoiceSummary.zh: 共 {total} 个可用声音，其中 {count} 个标注为日语。
ui.speechVoiceSummary.en: {count} of the {total} available voices are tagged Japanese.

ui.speechPhoneHint.zh: 手机上的声音来自系统 TTS：设置 → 系统 → 语言和输入法 → 文字转语音，确认首选引擎和日语语音包都已就绪，再回到这里点「重新检测声音」。
ui.speechPhoneHint.en: Voices on a phone come from the system TTS: Settings → System → Languages & input → Text-to-speech, make sure the preferred engine and its Japanese voice data are both in place, then come back and tap Check voices again.

ui.speechWindowsHint.zh: Windows 的声音来自系统语音包（SAPI）：设置 → 时间和语言 → 语音 里确认装了日语声音，再回到这里点「重新检测声音」。一个都没有的话，用下面的本地语音引擎装一个。
ui.speechWindowsHint.en: Windows voices come from the system speech packs (SAPI). Check Settings → Time & language → Speech for a Japanese voice, then tap Check voices again. If there is none at all, install the local engine below.

ui.speechStorageError.zh: 无法保存声音设置，本次页面仍可使用。
ui.speechStorageError.en: Voice preferences could not be saved. Speech is still available for this session.

ui.speechRoleHint.zh: 可为对话中的每个角色单独选择声音。
ui.speechRoleHint.en: Choose a separate voice for each speaker.

ui.engineDownloadHint.zh: 装一个本地引擎，日语就能离线朗读，声音也比系统自带的自然得多。装好后刷新本页，新声音就会出现在上面的列表里。
ui.engineDownloadHint.en: A local engine reads Japanese offline, in a far more natural voice than the system one. Reload this page afterwards and the new voices show up in the list above.

ui.downloadEngineWindows.zh: 下载 Windows 语音引擎

ui.guideIntro.zh: 本站不装也不启动任何引擎，只用系统已经装好的声音。手机通常缺一个日语 TTS 引擎，装好它，声音列表里就会出现日语；Windows 自带的声音读日语偏机械，可以换成本地的日语引擎。
ui.guideIntro.en: The site starts no engine of its own — it reads with the voices your system already has. A phone usually has no Japanese TTS engine yet, so install one and it appears in the voice list. Windows can read Japanese out of the box, but it sounds mechanical; a local engine replaces it.

ui.guidePhoneIntro.zh: 手机上不装引擎服务器，装一个 TTS 引擎就够了：它接管系统朗读，本站的「系统语音」就能选到日语声音。
ui.guidePhoneIntro.en: A phone needs no engine server — one TTS engine is enough. It takes over system speech, and the site's System voice option picks up the Japanese voice.

ui.guidePhoneStep1Body.zh: 点下面的按钮下载 APK，约 87 MB。第一次装商店以外的应用，系统会拦一下，按提示允许「安装未知来源应用」再继续。
ui.guidePhoneStep1Body.en: Press the button below for the APK, about 87 MB. Android blocks apps from outside the store the first time — allow installing from unknown sources and carry on.

ui.guidePhoneStep2Body.zh: 打开 设置 → 系统 → 语言和输入法 → 文字转语音，在「首选引擎」里选刚装的那个。各家菜单名字不太一样，找不到就直接搜「文字转语音」。
ui.guidePhoneStep2Body.en: Open Settings → System → Languages & input → Text-to-speech and pick the app you just installed as the preferred engine. Menu names differ by vendor; searching for text-to-speech gets you there.

ui.guidePhoneStep3Body.zh: 在同一个页面点进这个引擎的设置，下载日语语音数据。这一步要联网，装好之后朗读就完全离线了。
ui.guidePhoneStep3Body.en: From the same screen open the engine's settings and download the Japanese voice data. This step needs the network; afterwards reading aloud is fully offline.

ui.guidePhoneStep4Body.zh: 朗读设置里引擎选「系统语音」，下面的声音列表只列能读日语的声音：标了别的语言（中英等）的引擎会被隐藏，面板上会写明隐藏了几个。看到日语声音就成功了；列表空着并提示「只有非日语声音」，就回到上一步检查首选引擎并装日语语音包。刚装完没看到的话，点「重新检测声音」或刷新一次页面。
ui.guidePhoneStep4Body.en: In speech settings pick System voice. The list below shows only voices that can read Japanese: engines tagged with another language (Chinese, English and so on) are hidden, and the panel says how many. A Japanese voice means you are done; an empty list telling you only non-Japanese voices exist sends you back a step to check the preferred engine and install the Japanese voice data. Nothing yet right after installing? Tap Check voices again or reload the page once.

ui.guideWindowsIntro.zh: Windows 自带的日语声音能用，但读得像机器。下面这个本地引擎把开源日语语音装成系统声音：装好之后系统和别的程序都能用，本站朗读也完全离线。
ui.guideWindowsIntro.en: Windows can already read Japanese, but it sounds mechanical. This local engine installs an open-source Japanese voice as a system voice: the system and other programs can use it, and this site reads offline.

ui.guideWindowsStep1Body.zh: 点下面的按钮下载 VoicevoxSapiSetup.exe 并运行。这是个人发布的程序，没有代码签名，Windows 会弹「Windows 已保护你的电脑」，点「更多信息」→「仍要运行」即可。安装过程中会要一次管理员授权。
ui.guideWindowsStep1Body.en: Press the button below for VoicevoxSapiSetup.exe and run it. It is a personal release without a code signature, so Windows shows "Windows protected your PC" — choose More info, then Run anyway. Expect one administrator prompt during setup.

ui.guideWindowsStep2Body.zh: 打开 设置 → 时间和语言 → 语音，在「语音」的下拉列表里应该能看到刚装的那把嗓子。旧一点的系统在 控制面板 → 语音识别 → 文本到语音转换 里看。看不到就重启一次再打开。
ui.guideWindowsStep2Body.en: Open Settings → Time & language → Speech; the new voice should show up in the Voice list. On older builds look under Control Panel → Speech Recognition → Text to Speech. Not there yet? Restart once and open it again.

ui.guideWindowsStep3Body.zh: 刷新本页，在朗读设置里把引擎选成「系统语音」，再到声音列表里挑那个日语声音。列表没变的话点一次「重新检测声音」；刚装完的那一刻，刷新页面比重检测更管用。
ui.guideWindowsStep3Body.en: Reload this page, choose System voice in the speech settings, then pick the Japanese voice from the list. If the list has not changed, tap Check voices once; right after an install, reloading the page is the more reliable of the two.

ui.guideWindowsStep4Body.zh: 在 控制面板 → 语音识别 → 文本到语音转换 里把它设为默认声音，别的支持 SAPI 的程序也会跟着用。只在本站听就不用管这一步。
ui.guideWindowsStep4Body.en: In Control Panel → Speech Recognition → Text to Speech set it as the default voice and other SAPI programs will use it too. Skip this if you only need it here.

ui.guideFaq2Q.zh: 列出声音了，但日语读得不对
ui.guideFaq2Q.en: Voices appear, but the Japanese sounds wrong

ui.guideFaq2A.zh: 说明系统里有声音，但缺日语语音包——非日语引擎已经被隐藏，所以列表是空的。手机按上面那套的第 3 步补日语数据，引擎设置里一般能单独下载语言包；Windows 缺的是系统语音包，照 Windows 那一套装。
ui.guideFaq2A.en: The system has voices but no Japanese voice data — the non-Japanese ones are hidden, so the list is empty. On a phone, go back to step 3 of the phone steps and download it; an engine's settings usually offer language packs separately. On Windows what is missing is the system speech pack, so follow the Windows steps instead.

ui.guideFaqWindowsQ.zh: 引擎装好了，本站还是看不到它
ui.guideFaqWindowsQ.en: The engine is installed but this site cannot see it

ui.guideFaqWindowsA.zh: 先在 设置 → 时间和语言 → 语音 里确认这把嗓子真的在列表里。在的话刷新本页：浏览器是在启动时读系统声音清单的，安装时页面开着，新声音往往要重开页面或重启浏览器才出现；「重新检测声音」也管用，但刷新更稳。
ui.guideFaqWindowsA.en: First check Settings → Time & language → Speech and confirm the voice is really in the list. If it is, reload this page: browsers read the system voice list at startup, so a voice installed while the page was open usually needs a reload — or a browser restart — to appear. Check voices works too, but a reload is the more reliable of the two.

ui.guideFaq4Q.zh: 手机 Chrome 里一个声音都检测不到
ui.guideFaq4Q.en: Chrome on Android finds no voices at all

ui.guideFaq4A.zh: Chrome 只列出系统 TTS 引擎已经装好的声音。设置页的「系统声音」只显示能读日语的声音，别的语言的引擎会被隐藏并计数——这能区分两种情况：一个都没有、且提示「没有报告任何声音引擎」，说明 Chrome 看不到任何 TTS 引擎；提示「只有非日语声音」，说明引擎在、只缺日语语音包。前者去「文字转语音」里装并启用引擎，后者下载日语语音数据，然后点「重新检测声音」或刷新本页。
ui.guideFaq4A.en: Chrome only lists the voices the system TTS engine already exposes. The System voices row on the settings page shows only voices that can read Japanese; engines for other languages are hidden and counted — which tells the two cases apart: nothing at all, with a note that no speech engine was reported, means Chrome sees no TTS engine; a note that only non-Japanese voices exist means the engine is there and only the Japanese voice data is missing. For the first, install and enable an engine under Text-to-speech; for the second, download the Japanese voice data, then tap Check voices again or reload this page.

ui.storageRecovered.zh: 发现损坏的学习记录，已恢复可读取的条目。原始记录会保留为恢复备份，可在设置中导出。
ui.storageRecovered.en: Some saved progress is damaged. Readable records have been recovered; the original is kept as a recovery backup and can be exported in Settings.

ui.draftStorageError.zh: 浏览器无法保存测验草稿，请在离开前完成测验。
ui.draftStorageError.en: The browser cannot save this draft. Finish the test before leaving the page.

ui.retryPractice.zh: 错题重练（不会覆盖完整测验成绩）

ui.draftRestored.zh: 已恢复上次未完成的测验。
ui.draftRestored.en: Your unfinished test has been restored.

ui.androidAppHint.zh: 离线复习教材、词汇与测验 · Android 8.0 及以上
ui.androidAppHint.en: Offline lessons, vocabulary and quizzes · Android 8.0+

ui.speechHidden.zh: 已隐藏 {count} 个非日语声音。

ui.searchIntro.zh: 一次性搜索全部教材的文法条目、例句、单词与释义，日文和中文都能搜。
ui.searchIntro.en: Search grammar points, example sentences, vocabulary and meanings across every textbook, in Japanese or Chinese.

ui.searchPlaceholder.zh: 输入日语或中文，如「音楽」「效果」
ui.searchPlaceholder.en: Type Japanese or Chinese, e.g. 音楽 or 效果

ui.searchHint.zh: 多个词用空格分隔，每个词都要命中。
ui.searchHint.en: Separate words with spaces; every word must match.

ui.searchEmpty.zh: 没有找到匹配的内容，换个词试试。

ui.searchUnavailable.zh: 检索内容加载失败，请刷新页面重试。
ui.searchUnavailable.en: Search content failed to load. Reload the page to retry.

ui.clearProgressWarning.zh: 将删除全部收藏、已掌握标记、测验记录、未提交的测验答案和上次学习位置，无法撤销。需要保留的话，请先「导出学习记录」。
ui.clearProgressWarning.en: This deletes all saved and mastered words, test results, unfinished test answers and your last position. It cannot be undone; export your progress first if you want to keep it.

ui.checkUpdatesHint.zh: 对比已安装的 App 与网站上的最新安装包；有新内容时会提示下载，学习记录会保留。
ui.checkUpdatesHint.en: Compares the installed app with the latest package on the website. If anything changed you can download it; your progress is kept.
